items.title: Vali Makes It Two In A Row, Finn Strikes Back | Leogang DH World Cup
items.description:
This week we're joined by Alan Milway, Neko Mullaly and Olly Morris to break down all the action from an incredible weekend of World Cup downhill racing.

From Vali's dominant home victory to Finn Iles' winning run, revised race schedules, tyre choices and track evolution, we cover it all.

items.title: Out Of The 1 Win Club | THE B LINE 🇦🇹 | WHOOP UCI MTB World Series
items.description:
Finn Iles is back on the top step, history has been made, and a breakthrough victory for Adrien Boichis has shaken up the 2026 WHOOP UCI Mountain Bike World Series.

This week on THE B LINE, we break down all the biggest stories from Saalfelden-Leogang Salzburgerland, where Vali Höll made history in front of her home crowd, Finn Iles returned to winning ways in Downhill, and Adrien Boichis claimed his first Elite UCI Cross-country Olympic World Cup victory.

Join Ashleigh Wilmot and Josh Carlson as they go beyond the podiums and results, sharing stories about the riders, their personalities, and what they get up to away from the race track, giving you a different perspective on some of mountain biking's biggest names.

What was your standout moment from the weekend? Let us know in the comments below.

items.title: I'd Made Peace With Never Winning | Luca Shaw
items.description:
Fresh from securing the first UCI Downhill World Cup victory of his career, Luca Shaw joins us to discuss the long road that led to finally standing on the top step.

After years of being one of the fastest riders in downhill racing, Luca reflects on a career filled with near misses, fastest qualifying times, crashes, mechanicals and missed opportunities when victory seemed within reach. From qualifying fastest as far back as 2018 to finally securing that elusive first World Cup win in Loudenvielle, this conversation explores what it takes to stay motivated when success doesn't come immediately.

We also discuss the pressure of being the last rider on the hill, learning how to recover from mistakes during a race run, the mental side of elite downhill racing and why confidence and experience are just as important as outright speed.

This is a fascinating insight into the reality of competing at the highest level of downhill mountain biking and what happens when years of hard work finally pay off.

items.title: Leogang World Cup Breakdown | What Actually Went On
items.description:
Vali Höll continued her incredible start to the season with a second consecutive World Cup victory at Leogang, while Finn Iles secured a huge win in the men's race. But was this the weekend that changed the trajectory of the 2026 Downhill World Cup season?

In this week's Downtime Podcast post-race show, we're joined by Neko Mullaly, Olly Morris and Alan Milway to break down all the action from the Leogang UCI Downhill World Cup.

We discuss Höll's dominant home victory in front of a huge Austrian crowd, extending her winning streak and strengthening her position as the rider to beat this season. We also dive into Finn Iles' winning run, the impact of the revised race schedule, track evolution, tyre choices, changing conditions and the key moments that shaped the podiums.

As always, expect detailed race analysis, technical insight, paddock observations and plenty of post-race banter from one of the most exciting downhill weekends of the year.

items.title: The Team NOBODY Saw Coming | Neko Mullaly on Finding Asa Vermette and Building Frameworks
items.description:
In this episode of Just Ride, Rob Warner and Eliot Jackson sit down with Neko Mulally to talk about building Frameworks Racing from the ground up, from homemade bike prototypes to one of the most talked-about teams in downhill mountain biking.

Neko shares the story behind signing Asa Vermette, bringing Aaron Gwin onto the team, developing World Cup race bikes, and creating a team culture built around trust, performance, and progression. The conversation dives into bike setup, rider development, Hardline, American downhill racing, and what it really takes to compete at the highest level.

They also discuss the future of Frameworks, growing the sport in the U.S., and why simplicity, confidence, and passion still matter in modern downhill MTB.

Looking for more Just Ride? Check out all the episodes here: 
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLpfgeSePLuLxnuzGCXgpiQfMplr9bW-6c

Subscribe to Red Bull Just Ride here:

Join Rob Warner and Eliot Jackson in Just Ride as they delve into an array of cycling adventures. 

Whether on your screens or in your ears, catch them speaking to the biggest names from the world of mountain biking, road cycling, and everything in-between. We've got some incredible guests planned - and we will be bringing you Just Ride from all around the world. 

Come and join the ride!
